params.name: viewpoint
params.desc: 目标视角,省略时使用应用层 store.mainViewpoint

code: const vp = params.viewpoint || window.__chatStore?.mainViewpoint; if (vp) { await ssp.cameraController.setViewpoint(vp); return { message: '已回到主视角', data: vp }; } const roots = ssp.modelTool.getLoadedFloors().map((name) => ssp.modelTool.getFloorInfo(name)?.root).filter(Boolean); if (roots.length === 0) throw new Error('没有主视角或已加载模型'); const data = await ssp.cameraController.fitScene(roots, { view: 'iso', maxSafeDistance: 700 }); return { message: '未记录主视角，已显示场景全貌', data };
guard: 没有 viewpoint 又没有存的主视角,fallback 到 fitScene
setViewpoint 内部用 setLookAt (CR001 修复后,position + target 都同步)
